questions.evidence: Her skin is made of copper, which first shone like a new penny.

vocab.stem: The road up the hill is so ______ that many people have to get off their bikes and walk.
vocab.explain: 上坡路「陡峭」到很多騎士必須下車牽車走，故選 steep。stable（穩定的）、skillful（熟練的）、stiff（僵硬的）都不會讓人因此必須下車。

vocab.stem: It is not polite to ______ at people you do not know.
vocab.explain: 盯著不認識的人「看」很沒禮貌，stare at sb. 是固定用法，故選 stare。steal（偷）、skip（略過）、stir（攪拌）都不能接 at people 表示這個意思。

title: The Tailor Who Asked for Nothing
paragraphs: In a quiet [[suburb|L3-0862]] of Tainan, there is a small shop run by an old [[tailor|L3-0884]] named Mr. Huang. He is a [[talkative|L3-0886]] man who loves to tell stories while he works.

Every summer, many [[teenage|L3-0895]] students bring him school uniforms that no longer fit. A few years ago, he asked them to give him old uniforms they no longer needed. He washed them, [[mended|L3-0531]] the holes with a needle and [[thread|L3-0906]], and gave them for free to younger students whose families had little money. His [[stitches|L3-0847]] were so small and [[neat|L3-0568]] that the old uniforms looked almost new.

At first, some neighbors [[suspected|L3-0874]] that he was only trying to get more business. But when they saw him working late into the night without asking for a single dollar, their [[suspicion|L3-0875]] turned into respect.

Last winter, a girl named Amy brought him a bag of [[tangerines|L3-0888]] from her family's farm. "These are [[tasty|L3-0891]]!" said Mr. Huang. "I'm so [[thankful|L3-0903]] to you," Amy said in a [[sincere|L3-0797]] voice. "Because of your uniform, I never felt different from anyone else at school." Mr. Huang gave her a [[tender|L3-0899]] smile. For once, the talkative tailor did not know what to say.
zh: 在台南一處安靜的郊區，有一家由老裁縫黃先生經營的小店。他是個健談的人，喜歡一邊工作一邊講故事。
每年夏天，都有許多青少年學生拿已經穿不下的制服來找他。幾年前，他請學生們把不再需要的舊制服交給他。他把制服洗乾淨，用針線把破洞補好，再免費送給家境不寬裕的學弟妹。他的針腳又細又整齊，讓舊制服看起來幾乎像新的一樣。
起初，有些鄰居懷疑他只是想多招攬生意。但當他們看到他工作到深夜，卻連一塊錢都不收時，他們的懷疑就變成了敬佩。
去年冬天，一個名叫 Amy 的女孩送來一袋自家農場種的橘子。「這些真好吃！」黃先生說。「我真的很感謝您，」Amy 真誠地說，「因為有您的制服，我在學校從來不覺得自己和別人不一樣。」黃先生對她露出溫柔的微笑。這位健談的裁縫難得一次不知道該說什麼。

questions.stem: What did Mr. Huang do with the old uniforms?
options: He sold them to other tailors.
He fixed them and gave them to students who needed them.
He cut them up to make bags.
He kept them in his shop as a reminder of the past.
questions.explain: 第二段說他把舊制服洗淨、補好破洞，再免費送給家境不寬裕的學弟妹，故選 (B)。(A) 錯誤，文中強調他連一塊錢都不收。
questions.evidence: He washed them, mended the holes with a needle and thread, and gave them for free to younger students whose families had little money.

questions.stem: Why did the neighbors change their minds about Mr. Huang?
options: They saw him work late at night without taking any money.
questions.explain: 第三段說鄰居看到他工作到深夜卻一毛錢也不收，懷疑才轉為敬佩，故選 (C)。(D) Amy 來道謝是第四段的事，和鄰居改變看法無關。
questions.evidence: But when they saw him working late into the night without asking for a single dollar, their suspicion turned into respect.

questions.stem: The word "suspicion" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 鄰居原本「懷疑」黃先生只是想招攬生意，所以 suspicion 指「懷疑、不信任」，與 doubt 最接近，故選 (D)。(B) fear 是「害怕」，鄰居並不是怕他。
questions.evidence: At first, some neighbors suspected that he was only trying to get more business.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A kind tailor quietly helps students and wins the respect of his neighbors.
Mr. Huang's shop is the busiest shop in Tainan.
Students in Tainan must buy new uniforms every year.
Tangerines are a popular gift in winter.
questions.explain: 全文描述黃先生免費修補舊制服送給需要的學生，從被懷疑到贏得鄰居敬佩，最後受到學生感謝，主旨是善良的裁縫默默助人，故選 (A)。(D) 橘子只是 Amy 帶來的謝禮，是細節不是主旨。
questions.evidence: But when they saw him working late into the night without asking for a single dollar, their suspicion turned into respect.

vocab.stem: The police ______ that the man took the money, but they are not sure yet.
vocab.explain: 警方「懷疑」那名男子拿了錢，但還不確定，suspect that... 表示「懷疑某事為真」，故選 suspect。tighten（拉緊）、subtract（減去）、swell（腫脹）都不能接 that 子句。

vocab.stem: I am ______ to my friends for taking care of me when I was sick.
vocab.explain: 生病時朋友照顧我，所以我很「感激」他們，be thankful to sb. for sth. 是固定用法，故選 thankful。talkative（健談的）、teenage（青少年的）都不合語意，tender（溫柔的）也不能接 to sb. for sth. 表示感謝。

title: A Letter from Taipei
paragraphs: Dear Mia,

Thank you for your last letter. I loved your poem about the snow, especially the second [[verse|L3-0958]]. I have never seen snow, since I live in a busy [[urban|L3-0949]] part of Taipei where it never snows. Maybe [[someday|L3-0814]] I can visit you in winter!

Big news: I have started working as a volunteer [[tutor|L3-0940]] at a learning center every Saturday. I help young children learn English [[vocabulary|L3-0968]]. Some words are [[tricky|L3-0930]] for them, like "knife" and "island," because some letters are not [[pronounced|L3-0679]]. To make the lessons fun, my [[twin|L3-0941]] sister, Amy, sometimes comes and plays the [[trumpet|L3-0933]] while the kids sing.

Last weekend, my family drove our old [[van|L3-0951]] to the east coast. On the way, we went through a long [[tunnel|L3-0939]] under the mountains. We stayed on a farm with a hot spring, where we sat in a big wooden [[tub|L3-0936]] of warm water. The farmer also told us that sweet potato leaves are full of [[vitamins|L3-0966]], so we ate a big plate of them for dinner.
Please be [[truthful|L3-0935]]: Is my English getting better? I am so [[thankful|L3-0903]] to have you as my pen [[pal|L3-0605]]. Write back soon!
Best wishes,
Lisa
zh: 親愛的 Mia：
謝謝你上次的來信。我很喜歡你寫雪的那首詩，尤其是第二節。我從來沒看過雪，因為我住在台北熱鬧的市區，那裡從來不下雪。也許有一天我可以在冬天去拜訪你！
大消息：我開始在一間學習中心當志工家教，每個星期六都去。我幫小朋友學英文單字。有些字對他們來說很棘手，像是 knife 和 island，因為有些字母不發音。為了讓課程更有趣，我的雙胞胎姊姊 Amy 有時會一起來，在孩子們唱歌時吹小號伴奏。
上週末，我們全家開著那台舊廂型車去東海岸。途中，我們穿過一條位於山底下的長隧道。我們住在一座有溫泉的農場，在那裡泡在一個裝滿溫水的大木桶裡。農場主人還告訴我們，地瓜葉富含維他命，所以我們晚餐吃了一大盤。
請老實告訴我：我的英文有沒有進步？我真的很感謝有你這位筆友。快點回信喔！
祝好
Lisa

questions.stem: What does Lisa do every Saturday?
options: She plays the trumpet in a band.
She visits a farm on the east coast.
She helps children learn English words.
She takes singing lessons with her sister.
questions.explain: 第三段說 Lisa 每個星期六在學習中心當志工家教，幫小朋友學英文單字，故選 (C)。(A) 吹小號的是她的雙胞胎姊姊 Amy，而且不是在樂團裡。
questions.evidence: I have started working as a volunteer tutor at a learning center every Saturday.

questions.stem: According to the letter, why are words like "knife" and "island" hard for the children?
options: The children have never seen these things.
Lisa does not know how to say them.
Some of their letters are not pronounced.
questions.explain: 信中說這些字很棘手，「因為有些字母不發音」（knife 的 k、island 的 s），故選 (D)。(A) 這兩個字其實都不長，並不是困難的原因。
questions.evidence: Some words are tricky for them, like "knife" and "island," because some letters are not pronounced.

questions.stem: In paragraph 4, what does "them" in "we ate a big plate of them" refer to?
questions.explain: 前一句提到地瓜葉富含維他命，所以他們晚餐吃了一大盤的 them 指的是地瓜葉，故選 (A)。(B) 維他命是地瓜葉裡的營養，不能用「一大盤」來吃。
questions.evidence: The farmer also told us that sweet potato leaves are full of vitamins, so we ate a big plate of them for dinner.

questions.stem: What can we infer about Mia?
options: She lives in Taipei, near Lisa.
She probably lives in a place where it snows in winter.
She teaches English at a learning center.
questions.explain: Mia 寫了關於雪的詩，Lisa 又說「也許有一天可以在冬天去拜訪你」，可推知 Mia 住在冬天會下雪的地方，故選 (B)。(C) 錯誤，Lisa 的雙胞胎姊姊是 Amy。
questions.evidence: Maybe someday I can visit you in winter!

vocab.stem: This math question looks easy, but it is actually quite ______, so read it carefully.
vocab.explain: 這題數學看似簡單，其實相當「棘手」，所以要仔細讀題，故選 tricky。urban（都市的）、truthful（誠實的）、violet（紫色的）都不能形容題目的難易。

vocab.stem: Ben's parents found a ______ to help him with his English homework.
vocab.explain: 父母找了一位「家教」來指導 Ben 寫英文作業，故選 tutor。tunnel（隧道）、trumpet（小號）、vase（花瓶）都是物品，不可能幫忙寫作業。

title: The Whistle in the Drawer
paragraphs: Last summer, the Chen family got a surprise: their electric bill was almost twice as high as usual. "We're not [[wealthy|L3-0980]]," said Mrs. Chen. "We have to do something."

So the family began holding [[weekly|L3-0986]] meetings about saving energy. Grandma shared her [[wisdom|L3-0994]]: "If you are not using it, turn it off." Ben's little brother, a [[lively|L3-0497]] [[youngster|L3-1000]] of seven, was given a special job. Every time he found a light on in an empty room, he would blow a [[whistle|L3-0990]] and [[yell|L3-0998]], "Lights!" Soon, nobody wanted to hear that sound.

Ben searched the [[web|L3-0983]] for more ideas. He learned that many machines use a little power even when they are off, as long as they are [[plugged|L3-0648]] in, so he began to pull out plugs before bed. His sister [[wiped|L3-0993]] the [[dust|L3-0269]] off the fans, since clean machines work better. In winter, instead of using the heater, the family wore thick socks and enjoyed the [[warmth|L3-0975]] of hot tea.

A few months later, the bill was much lower, and the family hoped to cut their [[yearly|L3-0997]] costs, too. "You see?" Grandma said. "Small, [[sensible|L3-0777]] habits make a big difference." And the whistle? It now rests in a drawer.
zh: 去年夏天，陳家人嚇了一跳：電費帳單幾乎是平常的兩倍。陳太太說：「我們並不富有，得想想辦法才行。」
於是全家人開始每週開會，討論如何節約能源。奶奶分享了她的智慧：「沒在用的東西，就把它關掉。」Ben 的弟弟是個活潑的七歲小孩，他被分派了一項特別任務：每當他發現沒人的房間還開著燈，就會吹哨子並大喊：「燈！」很快地，誰都不想再聽到那個聲音了。
Ben 上網搜尋更多點子。他得知許多電器即使關掉了，只要插頭還插著，仍會用掉一點電，所以他開始在睡前拔掉插頭。他的姊姊把電扇上的灰塵擦乾淨，因為乾淨的機器運作得比較好。到了冬天，全家人不開暖氣，而是穿上厚襪子，享受熱茶帶來的溫暖。
幾個月後，電費少了很多，全家人也希望能降低一整年的花費。奶奶說：「你們看吧？微小而明智的習慣，能帶來很大的改變。」那個哨子呢？它現在靜靜躺在抽屜裡。

questions.stem: Why did the Chen family start to save energy?
options: Their electric bill was much higher than usual.
Grandma asked them to buy a new heater.
Ben read about it on the web.
questions.explain: 第一段說陳家的電費帳單幾乎是平常的兩倍，陳太太說家裡不富有、得想辦法，因此開始省電，故選 (A)。(C) Ben 上網找點子是開始省電「之後」的事。
questions.evidence: Last summer, the Chen family got a surprise: their electric bill was almost twice as high as usual.

questions.stem: What did Ben do to save power?
options: He cleaned the fan every week.
He pulled out plugs before going to bed.
He blew a whistle in empty rooms.
He turned off the heater in winter.
questions.explain: 第三段說 Ben 得知電器插著插頭仍會耗電，於是開始在睡前拔插頭，故選 (B)。(A) 清電扇是他姊姊做的，(C) 吹哨子的是他弟弟。
questions.evidence: so he began to pull out plugs before bed.

questions.stem: The word "youngster" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: youngster 指「年輕人、小孩」，原句說 Ben 的弟弟是個七歲的活潑 youngster，與 a young person 最接近，故選 (D)。(B) family helper 是受到「被分派任務」這句話誤導，youngster 本身並沒有幫手的意思。
questions.evidence: Ben's little brother, a lively youngster of seven, was given a special job.

questions.stem: Why does the whistle now rest in a drawer?
options: Grandma did not like its sound.
The family has formed the habit of turning off lights.
The family bought a new kind of light.
questions.explain: 哨子原本用來提醒家人隨手關燈；故事最後奶奶說「微小而明智的習慣能帶來改變」，哨子已用不到，可推知全家已養成隨手關燈的習慣，故選 (C)。(A) 文中說哨子收在抽屜裡，並沒有弄丟。
questions.evidence: "Small, sensible habits make a big difference."

vocab.stem: Please ______ the table with a wet cloth after dinner.
vocab.explain: 晚餐後請用濕抹布「擦」桌子，wipe the table 是常見搭配，故選 wipe。weep（哭泣）、yell（大叫）、whistle（吹口哨）都不能接 the table 當受詞。

vocab.stem: Grandpa has lived a long and full life, and his ______ helps the whole family make good choices.
vocab.explain: 爺爺閱歷豐富，他的「智慧」幫助全家人做出好的選擇，故選 wisdom。wax（蠟）、yolk（蛋黃）、zipper（拉鍊）都是物品，無法幫人做決定。

title: Just Take the Next Step
paragraphs: Three years ago, on my first day of high school, I stood at the school gate and [[stared|L3-0836]] at the tall buildings. I was a shy [[teenage|L3-0895]] girl who could hardly say a word in English class. Today, as a [[senior|L3-0776]] about to leave this school, I want to share what I have learned along the way.

On our first class trip, we climbed a mountain. The path was [[steep|L3-0842]], and after an hour, I sat down with a [[sigh|L3-0791]], wanting to go home. Then our teacher said something I will never forget: "Don't look at the top. Just take one [[steady|L3-0839]] step after another." Two hours later, we stood on the [[summit|L3-0869]] above the clouds.

I have used those words ever since. When English [[vocabulary|L3-0968]] felt [[tricky|L3-0930]], I learned a few new words every day. When I failed a math test, my [[tutor|L3-0940]] [[reminded|L3-0717]] me that mistakes are part of learning. Step by step, the road became easier, and my world began to [[widen|L3-0992]].

Of course, not every memory is a happy one. Some nights I [[wept|L3-0987]] over bad grades, and some close friends moved away. But I also found [[warmth|L3-0975]] in small things: a note from a classmate, a kind word from a teacher.

Today, I am [[thankful|L3-0903]] to everyone who walked this road with me. There are more mountains ahead, and I do not know which comes next. But I will carry the [[wisdom|L3-0994]] of that first trip with me. [[Someday|L3-0814]], when I meet a [[youngster|L3-1000]] who feels as lost as I once did, I will tell her the same thing: don't look at the top—just take the next step.
zh: 三年前，高中開學的第一天，我站在校門口，盯著高大的校舍。那時的我是個害羞的青少女，在英文課上幾乎一句話也說不出口。今天，身為即將離開這所學校的高三生，我想分享這一路上學到的事。
我們班第一次出遊時去爬了一座山。山路很陡，爬了一個小時後，我嘆了口氣坐下來，只想回家。這時老師說了一句我永遠不會忘記的話：「別看山頂，只要一步一步穩穩地走。」兩個小時後，我們站上了高於雲層的山頂。
從那以後，我一直照著這句話去做。當英文單字讓我覺得棘手時，我就每天學幾個新單字。當我數學考不及格時，家教提醒我，犯錯是學習的一部分。一步一步地，路變得好走了，我的世界也開始變得更寬廣。
當然，並不是每一段回憶都是快樂的。有些夜晚我為了糟糕的成績哭泣，也有幾位好朋友搬走了。但我也在小事中找到溫暖：同學寫的一張紙條、老師的一句鼓勵。
今天，我感謝每一位陪我走過這段路的人。前方還有更多的山，我不知道下一座會是哪一座。但我會帶著第一次爬山時得到的智慧繼續前進。有一天，當我遇見一個和當年的我一樣迷惘的年輕人時，我會告訴她同樣的話：別看山頂，只要踏出下一步就好。

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: To explain how to climb a mountain safely
To show how hard math tests are in high school
To share what the writer learned during her high school years
To ask students to join a mountain-climbing club
questions.explain: 作者在即將離校之際回顧高中三年，從爬山得到的啟示、課業的挫折，到生活中的溫暖，開頭就說「想分享這一路上學到的事」，故選 (C)。(A) 爬山只是作者用來帶出人生道理的經歷，不是文章目的。
questions.evidence: Today, as a senior about to leave this school, I want to share what I have learned along the way.

questions.stem: What did the writer's teacher tell her on the mountain?
options: To keep taking one steady step at a time
To go back home before it got dark
To look at the top of the mountain
To rest until the clouds were gone
questions.explain: 第二段老師說「別看山頂，只要一步一步穩穩地走」，故選 (A)。(C) 正好相反，老師要她「不要」看山頂。
questions.evidence: Just take one steady step after another.

questions.stem: What can we infer about the writer?
options: She has never failed a test.
She has become more confident than she was three years ago.
She wants to become a mountain guide.
She did not enjoy any part of high school.
questions.explain: 三年前她是在英文課上說不出話的害羞女孩，如今卻能站出來分享心得，還打算將來鼓勵迷惘的年輕人，可推知她比以前更有自信，故選 (B)。(A) 錯誤，文中提到她數學曾考不及格。
questions.evidence: I was a shy teenage girl who could hardly say a word in English class.

questions.stem: In paragraph 3, the phrase "my world began to widen" most likely means that the writer ______.
options: was able to learn and do more than before
questions.explain: 前文說她一步一步克服英文和數學的困難、路越走越順，因此「世界變寬廣」是比喻她能學會、做到的事比以前更多，故選 (D)。(A)、(B) 把 widen 照字面理解成房子或旅行範圍變大，文中並沒有提到。
questions.evidence: Step by step, the road became easier, and my world began to widen.

vocab.stem: After five hours of climbing, the team finally reached the ______ of the mountain.
vocab.explain: 爬了五個小時，隊伍終於抵達山的「頂峰」，reach the summit 是常見搭配，故選 summit。scholarship（獎學金）、vocabulary（字彙）、warmth（溫暖）都不能指山的某個位置。

vocab.stem: To win the race, you need to keep a ______ speed instead of running too fast at the beginning.
vocab.explain: 想贏得比賽，要保持「穩定的」速度，而不是一開始就衝太快，keep a steady speed 是常見說法，故選 steady。tender（溫柔的）、teenage（青少年的）、wealthy（富有的）都不能形容速度。
